# DotPlotChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders each data value as a dot positioned along a Cartesian scale.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new DotPlotChart(options?: DotPlotChartOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`defaultDotRadius`](#defaultdotradius): Default dot radius for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`dotColor`](#dotcolor): Dot colour.

### `defaultDotRadius`

```typescript
defaultDotRadius: number
```

Default dot radius for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).

### `dotColor`

```typescript
dotColor: Color
```

Dot colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/chart-showcase`:

```typescript
dotPlotChart8.dotColor = C_TEAL;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/share-ranking-charts/dot-plot-chart`:

```typescript
chart.dotColor = Color.fromHex(C_TEAL);
```
